modules.name: Production engine and scan coordinator
modules.description: Owns the JSONL API, safety gates, authoritative device state, and projection transaction ordering.
modules.execution: Receives versioned requests from Tauri, invokes device modules, and emits complete snapshots. Pause retains a resumable acquisition; operator Stop joins device cleanup, scan-worker return and durable terminal registration before releasing the task lock.

modules.name: Moxtek X-ray source
modules.description: Owns Moxtek discovery, binary serial transport, measured readback, and fail-closed beam shutdown.
modules.execution: One serial owner verifies source responses. A complete monitoring pair shares a five-second budget and fresh current-generation readbacks for 250 ms; 50 ms read slices allow priority OFF and hard deadlines to preempt. No command replay. Serial diagnostics flow to domain logs and scan.log.

modules.name: Native WPD/PTP camera candidate
modules.description: Owns camera discovery, exposure configuration, host-side capture, and image-file confirmation.
modules.execution: A dedicated COM owner handles WPD/PTP, descriptor-backed property support/options/dependencies in properties.rs, Nikon RAM capture and validated Live View; correlated ExposureEnded and complete NEF/hash evidence are distinct, and hardware certification remains blocked.

modules.name: RTS9060 Nano turntable
modules.description: Owns Nano identity validation, line protocol, motion acknowledgement, warning output, and emergency stop.
modules.execution: A serial worker executes one versioned command stream while the engine waits for confirmed motion states.

modules.name: Recovered RTS9060 Nano firmware candidate
modules.description: Preserves the approved, hash-verified firmware source candidate and its reproducible offline build and real-source host harness.
modules.execution: Pinned AVR source rebuild and host harness run offline; neither build identity nor VERSION text certifies device flash, physical motion or interrupt timing.

modules.name: Tauri desktop shell
modules.description: Owns native dialogs and paths, sidecar lifecycle, and IPC forwarding without owning scan state.
modules.execution: Tauri receives frontend commands, exchanges versioned JSONL with ct-engine, and returns engine snapshots. Normal close finishes after an owned engine exit even when it failed; update installation still requires successful exit and the domain maintenance report.

modules.name: Frontend engine contract
modules.description: Defines the TypeScript command and snapshot vocabulary shared by production and preview clients.
modules.execution: React reads complete snapshots and submits domain commands through EngineAdapter.

modules.name: Frontend engine client
modules.description: Selects the runtime adapter and exposes engine snapshots to React without fallback after Tauri errors.
modules.execution: The browser selects preview only outside Tauri; production commands use Tauri invoke exclusively.

modules.name: Browser-only workstation preview
modules.description: Simulates device and scan behavior for browser development; it never accesses physical hardware.
modules.execution: An in-memory firmware transport drives a preview workflow that emits the production view-model shape.

modules.name: React workstation shell
modules.description: Owns panels, menus, safety presentation, layout, themes, and static UI assets.
modules.execution: Fills the client area with an adaptive grid and one control scale, validates numeric scan drafts, and renders confirmed or unknown engine readings.

modules.name: Read-only 3D equipment scene
modules.description: Owns visualization geometry, theme conversion, camera navigation, and WebGL fallback.
modules.execution: Interpolates confirmed turntable feedback for read-only rendering, freezes unknown motion and never sends hardware commands.

modules.name: Frontend platform integration
modules.description: Provides desktop-only paths, dialogs, directory reveal, and log export behind small functions.
modules.execution: Calls Tauri only after confirming the desktop runtime; browser preview uses safe defaults.

modules.name: Build and verification tooling
modules.description: Owns dependency locks, build entry points, contract tests, module-map generation, and impact analysis.
modules.execution: Selects deterministic local gates and builds Windows MSI installers via tools/release/build-update-release.mjs; it must not contact real hardware.

modules.name: Sites-compatible static preview worker
modules.description: Holds the optional static hosted-preview worker that serves built assets, outside the desktop application and the safety control loop.
modules.execution: The worker only serves built assets with a single-page fallback; it must never expose device-control endpoints and cannot command production devices.

modules.name: Architecture, guides, and evidence
modules.description: Explains current architecture, operating constraints, historical plans, and verification evidence.
modules.execution: Current architecture documents follow source and tests; historical files must identify themselves as historical.

modules.name: Windows installer release tooling
modules.description: Owns installer templates, immutable versions, release signatures and identity verification; generated packages are excluded from source ownership.
modules.execution: release contains only the latest Windows MSI. Signatures, identities, license sources and build evidence stay in .cache/tests/release/<version>; .cache/cargo/release remains compiler output only.
